// Stairs and ladders: every flight runs north (z15 -> z11), top step flush in the upper floor layer.
import { flight } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
import { ladder_run } from "../vocab.mjs";

const rail = (g, x, z0, z1, y = 8, wood = "spruce_fence") => {
  for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) if (g.get?.(x, y, z)?.[0] === "air" || !g.get) g.set(x, y, z, wood);
};

export function build(g) {
  const flights = [
    [33, "spruce", 32], [44, "dark_oak", 45], [54, "spruce", null], [88, "dark_oak", 87], [91, "dark_oak", 92],
  ];
  for (const [x, material, railX] of flights) {
    flight(g, { from: [x, 3, 15], facing: "north", to: 7, material });
    if (railX !== null) rail(g, railX, 11, 14);

  // barn loft ladder, tower ladder (hatch at the belvedere floor), tank ladder

  for (let y = 1; y <= 6; y++) g.set(62, y, 14, "ladder", { facing: "east" });
  for (let y = 1; y <= 8; y++) g.set(78, y, 16, "ladder", { facing: "west" });
  ladder_run(g, 44, 8, 12, 9, "east", { hatch: "spruce" });
}

elements.md:6:- [ ] Lane x0..95 z0..4: gravel z2, dirt_path z1 and z3, coarse_dirt z0 and z4, y0; fill y-2 stone, y-1 dirt. P6 `lane_strip`.
elements.md:7:- [ ] Lantern posts x=0,12,..,84,95 z4: spruce_fence y1..3 + standing lantern y4. P6 `lamp_post`.
elements.md:8:- [ ] Plot fences: side columns x12i, x12i+11 z5..18 spruce_fence y1; front picket z5 with 2-wide fence_gate x12i+5..6; back z18. P6 `fence_run`.
elements.md:9:- [ ] Module cut: nothing crosses x12i / x12i+11 below y7; eaves and stacks inside the plot. All parts.
elements.md:10:- [ ] Every room lit (floor light >= 8), porches hanging lanterns, no mob spawn. P4 `hanging_lantern`.
elements.md:13:- [ ] Two 3-wide units x2..4 / x7..9, z10..15 under one front gable, party wall x5..6 full height, light_blue_terracotta clapboard, birch trim. P1 `clapboard_wall`, `pier_line`.
elements.md:14:- [ ] Two front doors x4, x7 (bamboo_door + glass transom y5), floor-length windows x2, x9 y3..5 with dark_oak_trapdoor shutters outer side only. P4 `door_unit`, `window`, `shutter`.
elements.md:15:- [ ] Shared porch x1..10 z7..8, posts x1,4,7,10, beam y6, gingerbread brackets, shed roof, steps x5..6. P4 `porch_run`, `bracket`, `front_steps`; P3.
elements.md:16:- [ ] Gable louvre vent x5..6 y9 (open birch_trapdoor) with birch_slab sunburst. P4.
elements.md:17:- [ ] Red_nether_bricks front-gable roof, birch verge, king-post truss. P3.
elements.md:18:- [ ] Twin back stack x3..8 z17..18, flues x4 and x7, fires (4,3,17),(7,3,17), hearth mouths (4,3,16),(7,3,16), top y10. P5 `chimney_stack`.
elements.md:19:- [ ] 4 beds (2 per unit, heads to outer walls), stoves (4,3,15),(7,3,15), tables. Furnishers.
elements.md:22:- [ ] Side-gable cherry_planks body z10..17, engaged galerie z7..9 under the same roof plane, dark_oak slim posts x15,19,22, beam y6. P1/P3/P4.
elements.md:23:- [ ] Steep dark_oak roof with bellcast kick slab row at the front eave, open rafters over the galerie. P3.
elements.md:24:- [ ] Two French-door pairs x16..17, x20..21 z10, warped_trapdoor shutters. P4 `french_pair`.
elements.md:25:- [ ] West gable-end exterior chimney x13..14 z12..14 fire (14,3,13), top y14, bricks + deepslate band. P5.
elements.md:26:- [ ] 4 beds (east chamber 2, two cabinets 1 each), salle stove. Furnishers.
elements.md:29:- [ ] Two-storey yellow_terracotta box y3..11, brick foundation y1..2, birch belt y7, frieze y11. P1.
elements.md:30:- [ ] Hipped nether_bricks roof, deep eave, polished_blackstone_brick ridge; front hipped dormer x29..32 y12..15 with windows x30..31 y13. P3.
elements.md:31:- [ ] Full-width porch z7..8: bricks pedestals + birch columns x27,31,34, hip porch roof y7..8, brick_wall cheeks at the steps. P4 `porch_run`.
elements.md:32:- [ ] Stair x33 z15->11 y3..7 with rail x32 z11..14. P1 `stair_run`.
elements.md:33:- [ ] West chimney x25..26 z11..13 fire (26,3,12), top y16. P5.
elements.md:34:- [ ] 4 beds upstairs; stoves; back stoop z17. Furnishers.
elements.md:37:- [ ] Plum crimson_planks ground storey, birch fishscale shingle upper storey and gable. P1/P4 `fishscale`.
elements.md:38:- [ ] Steep slate hip + front cross gable x39..42, valley. P3.
elements.md:39:- [ ] Corner tower x43..46 z7..10, 3 stages, glazed belvedere y13..14, copper cone cap to y22 with lightning_rod, string course y12. P1/P3/P4.
elements.md:40:- [ ] Wraparound porch: front z7..8 x37..42, west leg x37..38 z9..14; turned posts (37,7),(40,7),(37,10),(37,14); spindle frieze birch_trapdoor; brackets; swing. P4 `turned_post`, `swing_seat`.
elements.md:41:- [ ] Orange stained transom and landing window. P4.

input.summary:
P7 east parlour furnished in parts/room-42.mjs: orange bed on the east wall (foot 92, head 93, z10), a spruce table (fence and top slab) at (92,·,11) with a stair chair at (93,3,11), a flower pot on the table, and a hanging lantern at (92,6,11). Lane clear from the front door (91,3,10) to the partition door (93,3,12); make.sh gives 7 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE.
On a scratch mock shell (envelope, real stairs flight, this room) the room check is OK: 8 of 8 floor cells reachable, light min 10, no dark cell, fit OK. The real shell is still a stub in this copy, so the check here reads "no floor".
Not done: no dresser or shelf, no rug, and only 1 of the plot's 3 beds (the other two are upstairs in the other rooms).

waste.what: Worked out which cells of the parlour box the east stair flight occupies (x91, y3..6, z11..12 plus stringers) by running flight() on a scratch Grid and printing the cells.
waste.cost: one probe script, about 3 minutes including the wrong block-format guess
waste.tool: A plan/room query that lists the stair and stringer cells inside a room box (or mcd plan showing built stairs) would replace the probe.

waste.what: Walk and light could only be checked on a hand-made scratch mock (stone envelope, carved box, flight, the room's build) plus a copied rooms.json with the entrance moved to the front door, because the shell parts are stubs in this copy and the room check reports 'no floor'.
waste.cost: one mock script, one rooms.json copy, about 4 tool calls
waste.tool: mcd room with a --shell-stub or --from-envelope option, or a --entrance override flag, would make a single-room check possible before the shell is merged.

waste.what: Placed the table's fence, slab, pot and lantern cell by cell in layers() and checked lane clearance by hand (doorway first cells (91,3,10) and (93,3,12)).
waste.cost: a few layers() rows plus reasoning, no retries needed
waste.tool: A room-level furnisher helper (table_with_chair, lane-aware placement) that takes a box, a focal piece and the doorway list and returns free cells would have been quicker.

companions.task: Confirm the x91 east flight's steps and stringers inside the parlour box (x91, y3..6, z11..12) and the headroom above them, so the furniture keeps its lane and the walk check passes on the real shell.
Build a small dresser or wall shelf for the east parlour's free east-wall cells (a barrel or chest with a pot), since the room has no storage yet.

left: Walk and light were verified only on a scratch mock shell in /tmp/p49, not on the merged build; re-run mcd room once the shell parts are merged.
No dresser, shelf or rug: the room has only the bed, table, chair, flower pot and one hanging lantern.
Plot 7 needs 3 beds per unit; this room holds 1 (the ground-floor bed). Upstairs beds are in the other rooms, so the plot-level 'beds per unit' item is not ticked.
plan.md has no per-room checklist, and elements.md has no item specific to this room, so nothing was ticked; no Notes lines were added because no helper was missing.
